correctness.rationale: For |S| near 2n, each shore must omit a vertex so that selected same-shore pairs have an external common neighbor. At exactly one omission per shore, either both omitted vertices belong to intact matching positions, or they are the two endpoints of a deleted edge; the latter only works at t=1 due to other selected matched nonedges. With perfect matching deleted, no two-omission set works; the only three-omission patterns omit one deleted pair plus one additional vertex on the same shore, giving 2n(n-1) options; all indicated selected graphs are connected for n>=4. Independent BFS over all subsets for n=4,5 and t=0..n corroborates exact maxima and counts (n=4: 16,10,4,1,24; n=5: 25,17,9,4,1,40). This is a correct all-n proof, finite checking not its basis.
